system.hook: Never fires unless absolutely sure, no civilians.
system.biography: From Arizona, joined out of a sense of justice. Competitive shooter as a kid, natural sniper. Carries a photo of his wife. Deployed to Afghanistan, earning Achievement Medal with Valor. Attended Small Boat School. Terrified of making a mistake, shooting civilians, which has caused him to freeze up.

system.description: Small Boat Operations School trains personnel to operate fast craft in coastal, riverine, and littoral environments where speed, stealth, and judgment mean survival. Students learn boat handling in tight channels, night navigation using minimal light, silent approaches, and insertion/ extraction of teams under fire. They practice boarding drills, waterborne ambush tactics, and emergency responses such as capsized craft recovery and casualty evacuation over open water. Graduates emerge comfortable maneuvering in rough seas, threading mangrove tunnels, and running covert routes used by smugglers or insurgents, making this background ideal for characters specializing in maritime raids, river patrols, waterborne infiltration, or chase-and-interdiction missions in island or delta settings. Graduates of this school perform small boat operations and gain Strength +1.

items.name: Helmet with infra squad comms, plus NVGs.

system.description: Snipers are elite riflemen selected for patience, discipline, and exceptional marksmanship—the few who can turn a single well-placed round into a decisive tactical outcome. They operate at the edges of the battlefield, unseen, unheard, and often alone or paired with a spotter, shaping missions not through volume of fire, but through information dominance and surgical strikes. Snipers excel at reconnaissance, target interdiction, and overwatch, making them invaluable for players who prefer precision over brute force.
